scopeNote: Mars 2026-10-25 ~19:44 CDT: moves and animations are NOT replaced — real move names, mechanics, and timing are used verbatim. ONLY Pokemon creature names, sounds, art, and dialogue are excluded; this table contains no creature names, no sounds, no art, no dialogue.

classificationRules.kind: Status->status, Physical->melee (attacker travels to foe), Special->projectile (cast + projectile travels)
classificationRules.weight: heavy if power>=80 else light; drives windup/strike (light 250/80ms, heavy 500/115ms, per arenaCombat ARENA + treatments TIMING)
classificationRules.multiHit: true only where the decomp/game effect says MULTI_HIT; the timeline builder takes an explicit hits count at call time, so a move whose hit count varies (2-5) is staged per actual hit, not per table guess
classificationRules.makesContact: from FireRed flags where available; null = not in the extracted data, never assumed
